_comment: Hand-written entries for the Ask About Somesh index, on top of what tools/build_embeddings.mjs derives from the other data files. url is relative to the site root, or absolute for external links.

entries.title: Who Somesh is
entries.text: Somesh Mohapatra is an AI and analytics executive: Director of Analytics at Caterpillar leading data science, AI engineering and product management, with an MIT PhD in machine learning for materials and an MIT Sloan MBA in operations. A scientist, builder and operator who turns frontier AI research into running industrial systems.

entries.title: Current role at Caterpillar
entries.text: Director of Analytics, Head of Data Science and Head of Product Management for Caterpillar's Modern Manufacturing digital platform. Accountable for a 90+ person organization across the US and India.

entries.title: Based in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas
entries.text: Location: Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, Texas, USA. Works across the US, UK and India.

entries.title: Speaking, writing and conversations
entries.text: Writes and speaks about enterprise AI, digital twins, agentic systems and AI in manufacturing and supply chain. Always glad to compare notes with practitioners, researchers and leaders working on the same problems.

entries.title: How to get in touch
entries.text: Reach Somesh by email or LinkedIn message. Contact details, resume and links to LinkedIn, Google Scholar and GitHub.

entries.title: How he leads AI organizations
entries.text: A complete playbook for running data and AI: central standards with federated delivery, one governed platform with a model gateway and golden paths, risk-tiered governance anchored in NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001, agent authority tiers, unit economics, and measuring decisions changed and value created rather than models built.

entries.title: A hands-on builder
entries.text: Still writes code and builds prototypes: digital twin assistants on NVIDIA Omniverse, agentic RAG systems, on-device ML side projects, and this website's in-browser language model.

entries.title: Founder: ran a company with full P&L
entries.text: Co-founded and ran MatSci AI, an AI startup for manufacturing, scaling from two founders to a 30-person company across the US and India with full P&L ownership: revenue, costs, margins, cash flow, hiring and sales.

entries.title: Digital twins and physical AI
entries.text: Builds physics-based digital twins of factories with NVIDIA Omniverse and OpenUSD, with conversational AI so plant managers can query production, inventory and maintenance in natural language. Work shown at NVIDIA GTC and CES 2026.

entries.title: Generative AI and RAG in the enterprise
entries.text: Designed ChatDocs, an enterprise GenAI platform using large language models, hybrid retrieval-augmented generation and fine-tuning to extract terms from supplier contracts and quality certificates, saving over a million dollars a year.

entries.title: TEDxBoston talk
entries.text: TEDxBoston talk on how artificial intelligence can make rare diseases rarer, based on PhD work designing peptides for antisense drug delivery.

entries.title: Education: MIT PhD, MIT Sloan MBA, IIT Roorkee
entries.text: Studied at MIT (PhD in machine learning for molecular design), MIT Sloan (MBA, Leaders for Global Operations) and IIT Roorkee (B.Tech, Institute Gold Medalist, rank 1 of 110). University degrees and schooling.

entries.title: Google Scholar profile
entries.text: Full publication list on Google Scholar: 710 citations, h-index 12. Nature Chemistry, ACS Central Science, Nature Machine Intelligence, JACS Au, Accounts of Materials Research.

entries.title: LinkedIn profile
entries.text: Somesh on LinkedIn, where he publishes the Digital Iron, The Human Loop and Lab Series essays.

entries.title: GitHub
entries.text: Somesh's own GitHub: hands-on builds including Baby Senses Lab, Digital Twin History, a Michelin kitchen digital twin, Auto-Twin video-to-twin pipeline, LabTrends on-device health app, India Iceberg Index, and this website.

entries.title: Resume
entries.text: Full web resume with experience, education and certifications, printable to PDF.

entries.title: Writing and essays
entries.text: Essay series on LinkedIn: Digital Iron on AI for heavy equipment, The Human Loop on AI and the future of work, and Lab Series on models, agents and infrastructure.

entries.title: Certifications
entries.text: Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP), CFA Level I, CMA Part 1, Harvard AI Leadership program, NVIDIA multi-agent workflows, Lean Six Sigma.
